messages:
Maya L: Quick heads-up — planning to cut v0.22.0 tomorrow 16:00 PT. Need quick roll-call for owners: QA smoke, security review, docs/changelog, and the actual version bump commit. Please reply with ownership or blockers. :clock1:

Jonah R: I can take QA smoke and the post-cut quick health checks. I'll run the smoke-suite on staging and a short load run.

Jonah R: Plan summary:
```bash
# smoke suite
./scripts/run_smoke.sh --env=staging
# simple load check (local)
vegeta attack -duration=60s -rate=100 -targets=endpoints.txt | vegeta report
```
I'll share results in this thread.

Priya S: Security progress: looked at the dependency diff in the release branch — two transitive deps flagged, CVE-2025-xxxx and CVE-2026-yyyy. I'm opening a quick patch PR to bump them; ETA EOD. No runtime crypto regressions noted.

Samir K: Docs & changelog owner here. I'll prepare the changelog entry and migration note for the cache config rename. Need the exact flag name from the runtime team (is it `enable_kv_cache` -> `kv_cache_enabled`?).

Maya L: Yes, Samir — it's `enable_kv_cache` -> `kv_cache_enabled`. Please mention that existing dedicated pools will keep the old var for one release (compat shim).

Alex P: Release oncall FYI — I'll watch the canary and be ready for a rollback. Tag me when the canary starts.

Jonah R: For the smoke acceptance criteria I propose:
- all critical endpoints return 200 for smoke requests
- generation p99 < 350ms on staging under baseline load
- no new 5xx in logs related to tokenizer/kv cache
If we hit any fail, we hold cut. :no_entry_sign:

Priya S: +1 on the acceptance criteria. Also request: run the SAST quick scan against the release branch before cut. I can kick that off after the dependency PR merges.

Samir K: Draft changelog blurb:
"v0.22.0 — performance and stability updates. Notable: renamed cache flag (see migration note), dependency security bumps, improved batching heuristics."
I'll push the PR in ~2 hrs.

Maya L: Version bump plan: I'll handle the package.json/helm tag. My steps: bump package.json to 0.22.0, update chart version, open a single commit `release: bump v0.22.0` and link changelog + release checklist.

Maya L: Command I'll run locally before opening the PR:
```bash
git checkout -b release/v0.22.0
npm version 0.22.0 --no-git-tag-version
# update charts/Chart.yaml version: 0.22.0
git add package.json charts/Chart.yaml CHANGELOG.md
git commit -m "release: bump v0.22.0"
```

ReleaseBot: Deployment window reserved: 2026-03-18 23:00 UTC. Canary window: 20 minutes. Auto-rollback policy: enabled.

Alex P: I'll be available for the 23:00 UTC window. Jonah, can you post the smoke artifacts link (logs + vegeta report) here when done?

Jonah R: Yep — will post link to artifacts. If smoke passes, I'll mark "smoke: pass" and ping oncall.

Priya S: Security PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4321 — includes dependency bumps and SCA note. CI green except flaky test `test-tokenizer` which I'm rerunning.

Samir K: Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987 — changelog + migration note. Needs one more reviewer.

Maya L: Ok, here are the manual gating checklist items (short):
- [ ] Security PR merged (Priya)
- [ ] Smoke run green + artifacts (Jonah)
- [ ] Changelog + docs PR merged (Samir)
- [ ] Version bump commit open and CI green (Maya)
- [ ] Release oncall ack (Alex)

Alex P: Acked. I'll confirm once canary starts.

Jonah R: Smoke run done on staging. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/ smoke-1961 — vegeta report attached. Summary: no 5xx, gen p99 ~ 320ms. Marking smoke: pass.

Priya S: Security PR merged. SAST quick scan queued and passed baseline.

Samir K: Docs PR merged. Changelog updated with the migration blurb.

Maya L: Version bump PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4332 — CI currently running.

ReleaseBot: CI passed for release PR #4332.

Maya L: If there are no blockers in the next hour, we'll cut at 16:00 PT. Final call: any objections?

Jonah R: No objections from QA. :+1:

Priya S: No blockers from security. :white_check_mark:

Samir K: No docs blockers. :shipit:

Alex P: Oncall ready.

Maya L: Thanks all — cutting on schedule. I'll post the cut notice and tag infra during push. :rocket:
